session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bull Trap, Then Breakout and Channel Bear Trend' (8/19 into 8/20 footer). Bear trap at the 6455 open low, rally and a bull trap spike above 6470 into the beige boxed bars, then a breakout and channel bear trend stair-stepping down through a minor parabolic wedge (magenta dotted), boxed bear leg bars 12-24 and a small pullback bear trend (red text) along the pink minor wedge support to the 6419/6422 double bottom (bar 72) and the closing bull leg to 6435.
